page.overview:
Who is Axel?

Axel is a student at the Walrus School on Elbaph.

Axel is an average-sized giant child. He wears a helmet with an eye guard.

Axel has mischievous streak as he and Gustav attempted to capture humans for their amusement. However, he is quick to fold under pressure.

When the Straw Hat Pirates visited the Walrus School, Axel and Gustav chased Luffy, Zoro and Usopp, attempting to capture the humans. However, they were stopped by Ylva, Ronja and a third girl. When they were berated, Axel and Gustav quickly apologized.
